description_en: Retrieves the information about cloud computers that can be upgraded to a specified image version but have not been upgraded
description_zh: 获取可升级到指定版本镜像但尚未升级的云电脑信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-fota-pending-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --task-uid 'aot-c4khwrp9ocml4****' --desktop-id 'ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy****' --office-site-id 'cn-shanghai+dir-428216****' --desktop-name demo-computer --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFotaPendingDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the list of regions supported by cloud computers
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100
Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。

最大值：100
默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set the value to the `NextToken` value returned from the previous call to this operation. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The information about the image upgrade task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437001.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 镜像升级任务的信息。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437001.html获取该参数
parameters.name: task_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216071.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/216071.html获取该参数
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_name

FotaPendingDesktops.description_en: The list of cloud computers that can be upgraded to the image version corresponding to `TaskUid` but have not been upgraded
FotaPendingDesktops.description_zh: 可升级到`TaskUid`对应版本的镜像但尚未升级的云电脑列表

items.description_en: The cloud computer that can be upgraded to the image version corresponding to `TaskUid` but has not been upgraded
items.description_zh: 可升级到`TaskUid`对应版本的镜像但尚未升级的云电脑

CurrentAppVersion.description_en: The current image version of the cloud computer
CurrentAppVersion.description_zh: 云电脑当前的镜像版本

DesktopId.description_en: The ID of the cloud computer

DesktopName.description_en: The name of the cloud computer

FotaProject.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available
FotaProject.description_zh: 此参数不对外开放使用

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The ID of the office network

EndUserId.description_en: The ID of the connected user

Status.description_en: The status of the cloud computer

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
